artworks.title: Low Tide, Cos Cob Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial scene by the water's edge. A bridge with stone piers stretches across the horizon. Industrial structures and smoke stacks are visible in the distance. A weathered wooden building with steps leading up to a door is depicted on the left side. Piles of material are heaped next to the building. People are seen near small boats on the right side. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: Bacchantes
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows abstract forms of three human figures and a leopard. The figures have floral shapes on their heads, while the leopard is depicted in a reclining position through dappled and curved lines.

artworks.title: Clinton Fire Company, No. 41
artworks.dimensions:
image: 189 x 173 mm
sheet:  246 x 195 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a canal celebration. The scene includes a decorative float being pulled by two horses with three figures on it, a dam-like structure diverting water into waterfalls, a collection of buildings along a winding road leading into the hills, and additional carriages. The horizon features a range of hills or mountains meeting a body of water under a cloudy sky. The image is created with detailed linework and a monochromatic color scheme of gray and black, giving it a historic visual impression.

artworks.title: Zuni Indian
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 325 x 239 mm
Sheet: 423 x 300 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays the upper torso of an elderly person in a profile view. The individual has a weathered face with high cheekbones, medium-length hair under a cloth headband, and is wearing patterned clothing, hoop earrings, and a beaded necklace. The background features a softly rendered outdoor scene with a ladder and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Long Island Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image is a pastoral landscape with a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low, showing an expansive sky with clouds. A line of trees spans the horizon, with a dense cluster on the right. The vegetation is detailed with fine brushstrokes, creating a realistic texture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray. Closest to us, there is dense grass and a small body of water with water lilies. A path leads into the distance, where a person is walking, and cattle are grazing.

artworks.title: East Side Shops
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 152 x 343 mm
Sheet: 213 x 382 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a busy urban street scene. The image portrays a collection of storefronts and an array of signs in a bustling city setting. The foreground shows a number of people engaged in various activities, with several storefronts visible, including one showing a sign that reads "THE GREAT ATLANTIC & PACIFIC TEA CO." The shop windows are filled with products, advertisements, and prices for items like "Ginger Ale," and "Cider." Above the shops, windows indicate residential spaces with individuals visible inside. The artwork captures an intricate and detailed view of urban life.

artworks.title: Westward Ho
artworks.dimensions:
image: 208 x 316 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:  294 x 395 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a horizon showing a mountain range in the distance. In the foreground, there are various figures and animals, including people on horses and cattle. Two Native American figures, a dog, and covered wagons traveling towards the mountain are also visible. The painting is detailed, showing textures and prairie landscapes, with a color palette of sepia and brown.

artworks.title: South of France
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 112 x 153 mm
Sheet: 180 x 185 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image is viewed from an eye-level perspective. The horizon is high in the scene, accentuated by the silhouette of rugged hills. There are intricate structures etched on the hills. The style is a woodcut or etching technique with fine lines. The color palette is monochromatic with tones of black and white. A large tree stands on the left, intersecting a brick pathway. Stone pillars are visible, leading to terraced fields and buildings. Palm trees and a multi-storied building are on the right. Detailed clouds fill the sky.

artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in a wooden chair, reading a book. She is dressed in a long dress with puffed sleeves and a bonnet tied under her chin. The room has minimal furnishings, with a plate hanging on the wall.

artworks.title: Untitled (Girl on a Couch)
artworks.dimensions:

plate:   594 x 472 mm
sheet:  667 x 534 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a cushioned seat. She holds a flower and a fan in her right hand while resting her left arm on the armrest. She wears a formal gown with lace detailing and a fitted bodice. A sheer fabric covers her arms, and a bouquet of roses is beside her on the seat. She has delicate features and dark hair styled up. The background has sheer curtains with floral patterns and a potted plant on her left.

artworks.title: Five O'Clock Tea

plate:   543 x 743 mm

artworks.description: This image shows seven women around a table. They are dressed in elegant period clothing. The table is set for a meal or gathering. The women have different hairstyles and facial features. Some are seated, while others are standing or leaning. A dog is lying near the table. The setting appears to be outside with foliage and a building in the background.

sheet:  646 x 780 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a winter scene with a low horizon, trees, snow-covered ground, and a pale sky with delicate details in the branches. Tall trees surround the area with a muted color palette emphasizing the tranquil, cold atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Visit to the City
artworks.artist: Stephen James Ferris after William Thomas Smedley
artworks.dimensions:
image: 594 x 750 mm
sheet: 649 x 875 mm
plate:  578 x 830 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows multiple individuals in a grand entrance hall. On the left side, a woman is positioned on a staircase, wearing an elegant dress and holding a fan. Next to her is a statue on a pedestal. In the center, a man is about to ascend the stairs, carrying a bag. To the right, a group includes a distinguished man, an elderly couple, and a young girl. The man greets the couple warmly. The opulent interior features a tiger pelt rug and a carved sideboard with decorative pieces, illuminated with warm lighting.

artworks.title: Untitled (Woman in a Carriage)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 248 x 340 mm
sheet:  398 x 509 mm
plate:   277 x 369 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a horse-drawn carriage by the seaside, depicted from about her waist up. She is positioned slightly sideways, looking toward the viewer and holding a long, slender staff with a butterfly resting on top. Her facial features include soft, delicate lines and she has long, dark hair mostly covered by an elaborate wide-brimmed hat adorned with foliage. The woman's clothing is a long-sleeved, high-necked dress with a floral pattern. She is wearing gloves and holding the staff with both hands. The carriage, with its spoked wheels and wooden structures, is by the ocean, with waves gently lapping at the shore in the background and some foliage partially obscured in the foreground.

artworks.title: Robed in a Garment of Untrodden Snow
artworks.dimensions:
image: 304 x 700 mm
sheet:  465 x 824 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with trees, snow-covered ground, water reflecting branches, a line of shrubs and trees in the distance, an open sky, and a monochromatic color palette. The style is characterized by precise lines that capture textures of bark, snow, and twigs.

artworks.title: Marblehead
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with an elevated view overlooking a small inlet or river mouth. The horizon line features a village with a church at the center. The etching technique is used to create intricate lines defining the landscape, water, and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia and black. Close to us are rocky banks with moored boats and figures. In the background, houses and trees surround the church, extending into the countryside.

artworks.title: Kingdom of the Sun
artworks.medium: softground etching with drypoint and aquatint
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays flowing shapes and swirling lines creating an intricate abstract composition. The forms intertwine, resembling silhouettes of figures and foliage. The dark and light areas overlap, creating shadows and highlights.

artworks.description: The image features a man seated in a chair, holding a cigar in his left hand and a sheet of paper in his right hand. He is dressed in a pinstripe suit jacket and is leaning slightly to his right. The background is nondescript.

artworks.title: Alaska Seal Fisheries
artworks.dimensions:
image: 243 x 331 mm 
sheet:  321 x 405 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape with water leading to a distant horizon. Snow-covered mountains are in the distance, and seals rest on rocky outcrops near the shore. A canoe with two people paddling towards ships is visible. There are clouds in the sky, and another vessel emits smoke in the distance. The artwork is monochrome in shades of grey and brown.

artworks.title: Untitled (Native American Camp)
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 167 x 526 mm
Sheet: 345 x 703 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a river landscape viewed from slightly above. A calm river is central, reflecting trees and the sky. Above, a line of trees and teepees are visible against the sky. The brushstrokes are delicate, capturing details of trees and ripples on the water. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from light grays to deeper charcoal. Close, on the right, horses and a person on horseback stand in the river. In the distance, the landscape extends into hills.

The child has curly hair, wears a large hat, a loose, long-sleeved shirt, pants, and tall boots. The child is in a rustic setting, with a wooden structure in the background and straw or hay on the ground. Vines hang on the wall to the child's left.

artworks.title: Washington
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 585 x 485 mm (oval)
Sheet: 822 x 657 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man's upper body, including his head and shoulders. The man is facing slightly to the left, looking in the same direction. He has an oval face with prominent cheekbones, a strong jawline, and deep-set eyes. His hair is white or light gray, styled back with small curls on the sides. He is wearing a dark coat with visible buttons, a white cravat, and a high collar. The background is plain and neutral, contrasting with the dark tones of his clothing. The name "Washington" is inscribed below the portrait, along with additional text. The edges of the paper are worn.
